remarks: Awesome top floor 1 bedroom, 1 Full bath, corner unit, with TWO outdoor living areas, that add an extra 240+ square feet of living space. Overlooking the peaceful John Ryan Park and within walking distance to the train station, dozens of great restaurants and bars, The Maritime Aquarium, movie theater, distilleries, fresh seafood, etc...This one bedroom has a washer/dryer in the unit as well as parking for tenants and guests. Bedroom has sliders to its own private balcony where you can work from home or relax and enjoy your favorite beverage. Living room has access to a second private outdoor living area that adds to the enjoyment of this truly rare condo apartment. Excellent credit and application required.
